# Crypto build-vs-buy matrix

Lookup material extracted from the `crypto-boundary` rule. Read it when deciding whether a piece of
cryptographic or protocol work should use the platform, an in-house implementation, or a third-party
library. See `docs/design/00-overview.md` section 4.

## Five categories

| Category                                                                                                                                                    | Handling                                            | Rationale                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Cryptographic primitives (ECDSA / RSA / AES / SHA / HKDF / randomness)                                                                                      | Never hand-written -- use Web Crypto (`crypto.subtle`) | Rolling your own crypto is a cardinal security sin                               |
| OIDC/OAuth2 kernel, JWT issuance and verification, PKCE, refresh rotation, WebAuthn verification orchestration, social login, tenant isolation, envelope encryption | Fully in-house                                      | Core product; must be auditable end to end, zero supply-chain risk, clean licensing |
| Password hashing (Argon2id)                                                                                                                                 | `@noble/hashes` -- the single sanctioned exception  | Web Crypto has no Argon2, and PBKDF2 is not memory-hard (see password-auth rule) |
| base64url / CBOR / COSE decoding                                                                                                                            | In-house or a tiny dependency-free library          | Format codecs, not security-sensitive                                            |
| SAML XML-DSig / canonicalization                                                                                                                            | Mature library (xmldsigjs + @xmldom/xmldom)         | Hand-written XML signature code is a reliable source of vulnerabilities          |
